events.name: New York Giants at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Led by Drake Maye and Marcus Jones, the New England Patriots became the first NFL team to reach 11 wins this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drake Maye passes for 2 TDs, Patriots become 1st team to 11 wins, defeating Giants 33-15

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Jahmyr Gibbs and a defense that suddenly generated pressure and turnovers helped the Detroit Lions stay in contention for a playoff berth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jahmyr Gibbs rushes for 3 TDs and Lions get much-needed 44-30 win over Cowboys

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — With the game tied after a lackluster first half, Mike Macdonald knew his team needed a spark.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rashid Shaheed returns kickoff 100 yards for TD and Seahawks blow away hapless Falcons 37-9

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Christian Benford apologized with a laugh, because the Buffalo Bills cornerback wasn’t supposed to jump when he instinctively leaped to snag Joe Burrow’s attempt to lob a pass over his head.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills rally for 39-34 win over Bengals thanks to Josh Allen's 4 TDs, Christian Benford's pick-6

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Cedric Gray isn't concerned about Tennessee Titans fans wanting the first overall NFL draft pick for the second straight year.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tony Pollard runs for 161 yards and 2 TDs as Titans outlast Shedeur Sanders and Browns 31-29

events.name: Washington Commanders at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — The Minnesota Vikings had no bigger problem in this messy season than turnovers, with a league-worst minus-15 margin entering this week.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCarthy, Vikings rebound with 31-0 win over reeling Commanders, who lose Daniels to injury again

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Tua Tagovailoa warmed up pretty quickly against the New York Jets and put his cold weather woes on ice.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tagovailoa wins in cold, leads Dolphins to 4th straight victory 34-10 to remain unbeaten vs. Jets

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Tyler Shough has faced the two top teams in the NFC South and beat them both on the road.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie QB Tyler Shough's 2 TD runs lead Saints to a 24-20 upset of Buccaneers

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — The Jacksonville Jaguars are still reeling from the biggest collapse in franchise history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daniel Jones hurt in Jaguars' 11th consecutive home win against the Colts, 36-19

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — For a while now, Mike Tomlin and the Pittsburgh Steelers have walked the fine line between success and recriminations.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late reversal helps Steelers hold on for 27-22 win over Ravens and sole possession of division lead

events.name: Denver Broncos at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — This wasn't a typical Broncos game. For the first time this season, they didn't trail, and the final minutes were not overly stressful.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos beat Raiders 24-17 to extend winning streak to 10 games as Geno Smith injured

events.name: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Keisean Nixon couldn't have picked a better time to get his first interception of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Keisean Nixon has game-sealing INT and Packers overtake Bears for NFC North lead with 28-21 win

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Matthew Stafford dominated on the field before being serenaded with “M-V-P!” chants off of it, soaking in some locker room praise from teammates after another stellar performance that led his Los Angeles Rams to a 45-17 win over the Arizona...
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford and Puka Nacua help Rams stay tied atop NFC West with 45-17 win over Cardinals

events.name: Houston Texans at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The Houston Texans never made their trip to Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday night into anything more than their next game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans stifle Patrick Mahomes and Chiefs in 20-10 victory to keep pace in AFC South race

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Justin Herbert stiff-armed the opposition with his broken left hand, the defense forced big plays and the Los Angeles Chargers eked out a victory to move within two games of first place in the AFC West.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers' Dicker kicks winning field goal, Jefferson's interception seals 22-19 OT win over Eagles

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Maybe Kirk Cousins should've been starting the entire season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kirk Cousins leads Falcons to 29-28 comeback victory over the reeling Buccaneers

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Caleb Williams rolled toward the right sideline and unleashed a pass he probably had no business attempting. DJ Moore went up in a crowd in the back of the end zone and came...
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams throws for 2 TDs, Bears pound Browns even as Myles Garrett closes in on sacks record

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — The Baltimore Ravens served notice that they have plenty of fight left as they pursue a third straight AFC North title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson's 2 TD passes, long pick-6 propel Ravens to 24-0 win over Bengals

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The final images of the Kansas City Chiefs' postseason pursuit were Patrick Mahomes getting helped to the locker room with what turned out to be a
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes tears ACL as Chargers eliminate Chiefs from playoff contention with 16-13 victory

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — The New England Patriots are still in good position to win the AFC East. But the Buffalo Bills made sure it would have to happen on another day, against a different opponent.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills rally from 21-point deficit to beat Patriots 35-31, stay alive in AFC East race

events.name: Washington Commanders at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Marcus Mariota emerged from the Washington Commanders' first victory celebration since Oct. 5 with a sense of relief. Beating the New York Giants...
headlines.shortLinkText: Commanders beat the Giants 29-21 to end their losing streak at 8 games

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts smacked A.J. Brown helmet-to-helmet after a touchdown pass for a celebration that seemed to release the pent-up tension that came tethered to a losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts rebounds with 3 TD passes as Eagles snap losing streak in 31-0 rout of Raiders

events.name: New York Jets at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — This was Trevor Lawrence at his finest, a franchise quarterback making plays with his arm and his legs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars overwhelm Jets from start to finish in 48-20 rout, reach 10 wins

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — The Houston Texans have shaken off their awful start to the season with a six-game winning streak that has them in the thick of the AFC playoff race with three regular-season games left.
headlines.shortLinkText: C.J. Stroud leads Texans to 6th straight win, 40-20 over Cardinals

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — The Denver Broncos were slogging their way through a rare clunker Sunday against the Green Bay Packers when cornerback Pat Surtain II delivered the game-saving takeaway.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Nix's 4 TD passes lead Broncos to 34-26 win over Packers, who lose Micah Parsons to injury

events.name: Detroit Lions at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — The Los Angeles Rams faced their biggest deficit in more than two months when they fell 10 points behind Detroit with 30 seconds left in the first half. Even worse, both their offense and their defense felt they were letting each other down.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford rallies Rams to 41-34 victory over Lions, clinching another playoff berth

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — A rookie quarterback who made his first start in midseason and a kicker from Northern Ireland who made his NFL debut three games ago stunted the Carolina Panther's playoff push.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shough's clutch drive and Smyth's kick lift the Saints past the Panthers, 20-17

events.name: Tennessee Titans at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — The San Francisco 49ers know their high-powered offense will need to carry the load if they are going to make a deep playoff run.
headlines.shortLinkText: Purdy's 3 TD passes lead 49ers to 37-24 win over Titans

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Jason Myers has quietly been a big part of the Seattle Seahawks' success this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks outlast Philip Rivers and Colts 18-16 on Jason Myers' 56-yard field goal

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — The last time Dak Prescott and the Dallas Cowboys were on their home field, they had finished a two-game sweep of last season's Super Bowl teams to spark talk of a rally to a playoff spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott and Cowboys watch playoff hopes all but vanish in 34-26 loss to Vikings

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — It felt a little bit like Green Bay. And for Aaron Rodgers, it looked a little like Green Bay, too.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aaron Rodgers and Steelers freeze out Dolphins, stay atop AFC North with 28-15 win

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Mike Macdonald was in no mood to play for a tie, and the Los Angeles Rams’ defense had no interest in letting Sam Darnold connect with any of his top receiving options.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks overcome 16-point deficit to stun Rams 38-37 in OT in NFC West showdown

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — As the percussive horns of Stevie Wonder's “Sir Duke” filled the air, Philadelphia Eagles coach Nick Sirianni — wearing a black T-shirt bearing the words, “Been there, won that” — made the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts and the Eagles win their second NFC East title in a row by beating the Commanders 29-18

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Caleb Williams felt it as soon as the ball left his hand. Then, in a flash, the Bears were celebrating yet another wild win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears stun Packers 22-16 with improbable rally as Williams finds Moore for winning score in OT

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — James Cook continues to show opposing defenses that they have to factor in more than Josh Allen when facing the Buffalo Bills.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cook's 117-yard, 2-TD performance propels Bills closer to playoff berth with 23-20 win over Browns

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Justin Herbert is getting more comfortable by the week with his broken left hand that's heavily protected.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Herbert keeps Chargers rolling toward playoffs with 34-17 win over Cowboys

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — The Tennessee Titans spent a few extra minutes celebrating a rare achievement for a franchise struggling through its fourth consecutive losing season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans knock Gardner Minshew out of game and end 11-game home skid, beating Chiefs 26-9

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Joe Burrow is having fun playing football.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Burrow throws for 309 yards and 4 TDs as Bengals rout Dolphins 45-21

events.name: New York Jets at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — A surprise 38-yard touchdown pass from Taysom Hill to Chris Olave might have deprived New Orleans Saints kicker Charlie Smyth a chance to set a club record in just his fourth career game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Olave's 2 TDs and Smyth's 5 field goals help Saints top Jets 29-6 for a third straight win

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at New York Giants

headlines.description: — J.J. McCarthy had already injured his right, throwing hand by the time he ran for a touchdown. Minnesota Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell asked the...
headlines.shortLinkText: J.J. McCarthy gets injured as the Vikings hand the Giants their ninth loss in a row

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — The playoff-starved Carolina Panthers left the locker room Sunday happy, but not yet satisfied.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryce Young throws 2 TDs, Panthers finally beat Bucs 23-20 to take over first place in NFC South

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence is playing the best ball of his five-year career and now he has a signature win to show for it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Lawrence's 4 TDs propel Jaguars past Broncos 34-20, ending Denver's 11-game winning streak

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Bijan Robinson had another outstanding game running the ball and catching it, talented tight end Kyle Pitts
headlines.shortLinkText: Bijan Robinson leads Falcons to 2nd straight win, 26-19 over woeful Cardinals

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — The Pittsburgh Steelers survived a wild finish, pushing Detroit to the brink of playoff elimination and boosting their chances of winning their division for the first time in five years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers outlast Lions 29-24 in wild finish when penalty on St. Brown negates Goff's winning TD

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — Houston’s struggles Sunday in a victory over the Las Vegas Raiders left some on the Texans top-ranked defense feeling a bit disappointed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans extend winning streak to 7 with 23-21 victory over Raiders

events.name: New England Patriots at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — Hopefully the rest of the NFL enjoyed the respite.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drake Maye leads the Patriots to a 28-24 win over the Ravens that clinches a playoff spot

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — San Francisco's offense is revving up just in time for the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Purdy throws career high 5 TD passes and leads 49ers to 5th straight win, 48-27 over the Colts

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — The Dallas Cowboys had every excuse for starting the game with a thud. Instead, they roared out in front and made the most of a road trip on Christmas Day.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott throws for 307 yards and 2 TDs to lead Cowboys past skidding Commanders 30-23

events.name: Detroit Lions at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — Harrison Smith reveled in his moment with the roaring Minnesota crowd, blowing kisses during an extended showing on the videoboard near the end of one of his best games in a 14-year career.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings eliminate Lions with defense-dominating 23-10 victory, racking up 6 turnovers and 5 sacks

events.name: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Broncos coach Sean Payton sent his offense back onto the field on fourth down Thursday night, the ball inside the Kansas City Chiefs' 10-yard line and less than 2 minutes left on the clock — and no intention of ever snapping it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nix's late TD pass and stand by Broncos defense finishes off 20-13 win over Chiefs

events.name: Houston Texans at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — C.J Stroud’s dynamic first quarter was merely the opening act for the Houston Texans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans' defense swarms Chargers after offense's fast start in playoff-clinching victory

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — With their backs against the wall, the Baltimore Ravens made sure they wouldn't underutilize Derrick Henry again.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derrick Henry's virtuoso performance helps Ravens stay alive with 41-24 win over Packers

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Ja'Marr Chase caught two touchdown passes from Joe Burrow, who threw for 305 yards as the Cincinnati Bengals beat the Arizona Cardinals 37-14 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ja'Marr Chase has two TD catches as Bengals breeze past Cardinals 37-14

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Cleveland Browns
New Orleans Saints at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — The New Orleans Saints may just have their quarterback of the future now with how Tyler Shough is playing for first-year coach Kellen Moore.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyler Shough rallies the Saints with a big second half to beat the Titans 34-26

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence took the Jacksonville Jaguars back to the playoffs with his nearly flawless work through the air.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Lawrence runs for 2 scores as Jaguars close in on AFC South title with 23-17 win over Colts

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Miami Dolphins
New England Patriots at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Drake Maye and the New England Patriots took care of things on their end to become AFC East champions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots get career-high 5 TD passes from Maye in 42-10 rout of Jets, win AFC East a few hours later

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — The Seattle Seahawks are doing everything they can to wrap up the No. 1 seed in the NFC.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks beat Panthers 27-10 for 6th straight win, still need to beat 49ers for No. 1 seed

events.name: New York Giants at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — The Raiders' fate Sunday might have been sealed earlier in the week when management took three key players out of the lineup and placed them on injured reserve.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders in position for top draft pick after 34-10 loss to Giants

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — As Jalen Carter and his Philadelphia teammates celebrated in the end zone after making one last crucial stop, Buffalo’s Josh Allen removed his helmet and yelled out in frustration.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles hang on to beat Bills 13-12 when Josh Allen misses an open Khalil Shakir on 2-point try

events.name: Chicago Bears at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Brock Purdy and the San Francisco offense did everything they could for the first 58 minutes in a nearly flawless performance. At the end, they were just spectators when the beleaguered defense finally came through with a stop.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Purdy and the 49ers hang on to beat the Bears 42-38 and have a shot at top NFC seed

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — A Los Angeles Rams team that spent most of the season competing for the best record in the NFL now is third in its division, saddled with a two-game losing streak and bound to open the playoffs on the road.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robinson runs for 195 yards as Falcons recover to upset Rams 27-24 on 51-yard field goal by Gonzalez
